description: Unsigned transaction for one backer action, checked against the contract for this wallet: vote_round (for or against the round proposed by the founder), vote_release (for or against the capital release requested in a round, with an amount of kept tokens), refund (base contribution of a raise that missed its goal), redeem (remaining capital of a round, against kept tokens). Signed and sent by the user's or the agent's own wallet.
